summary: CPR-1 iter 89 end-to-end verification. Backend: 73/73 green — 59 deterministic (test_cpr1_foundation.py + test_cpr1_ingestion.py) + 14 live-endpoint tests (test_cpr1_endpoints.py) covering all 10 care-plan routes: auth-gate 401, upload+extraction population (classification=5, effective_from=2026-07-01, effective_to=2026-09-30, provider='Better Care', quarterly_budget=8435, services>=2), list with latest_findings_by_severity counts, detail shape {plan, extraction, latest_run, findings, history}, notes patch persistence, delete→archived→restore round-trip, cross-user isolation (403 for user B), anti-hallucination structured-extraction leak check for 's.999-9' (clean). One live analyse run against a fresh Louisa upload: status flipped uploaded→active, findings sorted compliance→choice→efficiency→info, EVERY citation resolved to an allowlist entry or 'Verification required' (no fabricated s.999-9). Frontend: /app/care-plans store + /app/care-plans/:id detail render correctly for cathy — 7 active rows, findings-counts chips, three tabs (Review/Plan/History) all populated, meeting-artefact renders with verbatim question-script and 13 finding-cards for seed plan 6a1510db, notes save persists via API, services-table + history-run-0 both render. ONE HIGH-PRIORITY FRONTEND BUG surfaced: CarePlanReviewer.jsx checks `access === 'ready'` but useToolAccess only returns 'loading'|'allowed'|'blocked' — so the top-right link-saved-plans link AND the cp-save-cta 'Save this plan for future reviews' block NEVER render for a paid authenticated user. Instead the anonymous 'Start free trial' panel shows via the `access !== 'ready'` fallback on line 238. Simple 3-line typo fix (see action items).

ui_bugs.issue: Wrong string comparison — `access === 'ready'` will never match because useToolAccess returns 'allowed'/'blocked'/'loading'. This hides the `link-saved-plans` top-right link AND the `cp-save-cta` / `cp-save-btn` block AND the `link-open-saved-plan` follow-up. A logged-in Family/Solo user therefore has no path from the tool page to /app/care-plans and can NOT save a reviewed plan. The `access !== 'ready'` branch (line 238) then wrongly renders the anonymous 'Start free trial' panel to paid users.

action_items: HIGH — In /app/frontend/src/pages/tools/CarePlanReviewer.jsx replace `access === "ready"` (lines 89, 202) with `access === "allowed"` and `access !== "ready"` (line 238) with `access !== "allowed"`. useToolAccess.js emits 'loading'|'allowed'|'blocked' — never 'ready'. Without this fix the P0 'Save this plan for future reviews' CTA and the top-right 'Your saved plans' link never render for logged-in Family/Solo users, and the 'Start free trial' fallback wrongly renders instead. Verify via cathy@example.com: after Review my care plan → cp-save-cta must appear and clicking cp-save-btn must POST /api/care-plans/upload and reveal link-open-saved-plan.

LOW — Consider seeding a canonical `jeremy@test.com / testpass123` user for cross-user tests. It doesn't exist in the preview DB; I created cpr1-iso-tester@example.com / Wq9!hpJ4Hnc6xF (Solo trial) instead and pinned it in test_cpr1_endpoints.py.

LOW — /app/care-plans store shows 8 archived rows during the smoke-run (from prior iterations' test data). Consider a scheduled purge of TEST_-prefixed plans or gating archived visibility to non-test data.
critical_code_review_comments: CarePlanReviewer.jsx guards its three save-related UI elements with a string literal ('ready') that does not appear in the hook's return contract (useToolAccess.js only emits 'loading'|'allowed'|'blocked'). The typo is silent because no error is thrown; the entire authenticated-save flow is dead code as shipped. Consider extracting a shared const or using a typed union to prevent this class of drift.

care_plans.py hardcodes REFERENCE_SNAPSHOT_ID='static-v1-2026-07-01'; when the snapshot bumps this needs to be lifted to env or a DB collection so historical review-runs stay pinned to the reference version they used.

care_plans.py imports `get_current_user_id`, `_require_paid_plan` from `server` inside build_care_plans_router() — this circular-import guard works but couples the router to server.py wiring. Same pattern exists elsewhere so acceptable.

care_plans.py the analyse endpoint fires a live Claude Sonnet 4.5 call synchronously (blocking the request 15–30s). Under load this will exhaust the FastAPI worker pool. Consider offloading to a background job with a polling endpoint (spec §E does allude to this).

rca_of_the_issue: CarePlanReviewer.jsx was written against a hypothetical `useToolAccess` contract that returns 'ready'. The actual hook (useToolAccess.js) returns 'allowed'|'blocked'|'loading'. String equality silently fails, hiding the P0 save flow behind a dead branch. Every OTHER tool page (BudgetCalculatorTool, ClassificationCheck, ContributionEstimator, FamilyCoordinator, PriceCheckerTool, ReassessmentLetter) uses `access === 'blocked'` — only CarePlanReviewer diverged with the 'ready' literal, confirming the typo scope. Mitigation: 3-line search-and-replace ('ready' → 'allowed').
